rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: ADesmanod
Exhibition name: André Eve ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michel Adam (France, 2002).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera as 'André Eve'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot and pink. Mild fragrance. up to 30 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Very large, very double, borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Medium, long buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 35" (80 to 90cm). Width: up to 16" (up to 40cm).
